summary: Class 7 ICSE Chemistry Topic 06: Acids, Bases, Salts & Indicators in the warm editorial aesthetic (#fbfaf7 ivory canvas, Newsreader serif, rich black #161514). Features Arrhenius definitions, organic vs mineral acids, neutralization reactions (Acid + Base -> Salt + Water), and the master indicator color transition matrix (Litmus, Phenolphthalein, Methyl Orange). Zero SVGs.
